race.comment: LET'S GO BRANDON (2) returns in the new colours of the Backhouse yard and is a handy type on his day as a relatively lightly raced 6YO. Was sent around fav in both starts last campaign without striking but was far from disgraced. Boudvillain's booking adds confidence he can  make a bright return. PARTHENOPE (4) returns after a year spell and looks ready following a Canberra Acton trial win. Drawn to enjoy a good run on the speed. One of the main contenders. FAERYWOOD (6) has put together back-to-back placings after scoring three back at Sapphire Coast. Suitably placed so anticipating him to make his presence felt. DAWN ON ME (3) boasts a fitness edge and has good tactical speed. Could steal it if left alone.
